roles.name: Project Manager
roles.description: Owns planning, priorities, dependencies, acceptance criteria, project state, and handoffs.

roles.name: Implementation Worker
roles.description: Executes scoped work, validates it, and reports evidence, blockers, and discoveries.

roles.name: System Architect
roles.description: Designs scalable technical boundaries, interfaces, invariants, and migration paths.

roles.name: Independent Reviewer
roles.description: Independently verifies completed work against requirements and looks for regressions or hidden defects.

roles.name: Researcher
roles.description: Investigates technologies, evidence, alternatives, and unknowns for project decisions.

roles.name: General
roles.description: Flexible project conversation without a narrow operating role.
